title: Neon Rush: City Escape
description: High-velocity 3D endless runner. Dash across 3 cyber lanes, leap over laser hurdles, slide under neon barriers, and escape the grid.
author: AwaisGames Studio

controls.desktop: A / D or Left / Right to switch lanes · W or Up Arrow or Space to Jump · S or Down Arrow to Slide · P to Pause
controls.mobile: Swipe Left / Right to switch lanes · Swipe Up to Jump · Swipe Down to Slide
